title: Certifying the check and opening the Dunbar Bank account
summary: Buck sided with Nazarro; Bubbles got the check certified and opened a Buck and Bubbles account, but the bank froze him out, and he still has the checkbook.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So what happened is that when I don't give him the check, Buck now don't want to do as I'm saying, he want to do what Nazarro is saying and I'm mad at him, I'm ready to kill him. He don't know it but finally they subsided. He told Buck, "He's taken your money he's going to spend it so-and-so-and so." Nat tells him. When Nat leaves the dressing room and goes back to the office I tell Buck, I says, "If you meet me tomorrow in front of the Dunbar Bank at such and such a time you'll get your money. And I'm going to pay him off in a check. Do you hear what I'm saying? But I don't want his money, I

don't want Nazarro's money, I don't want anybody's money. Just want to set up this business arrangement. That's all I want to do. So he's there and what do you think they did -- I took the check -- now, wait. I took that check made to Buck and Bubbles and carried it to the Chase National Bank and had it certified before I went to the bank with it. Do you understand? I can't do it just dry / long so, 'cause I got to get Buck -- I'll get the bank to certify the check. Understand? Then I go uptown the next day with the check to the bank to open an account in the name of Buck and Bubbles. Certified check, it's got to be cash money. Here it is, I couldn't go up there with no check without being certified. And I got the bank -- you know what they told me at the bank? They opened an account, but would you believe that they would tell me that they couldn't give me a certain amount of the money out of that check. And I says why. "Honey, that's this bank over here, but the manager of this bank over here

was over there at another bank at 135th Street and 7th Avenue. I went from this bank over to the other one and when I got through with this bank, they tried to shush me. I'm an honest man, every cent. I talked about -- the manager's face was red and the guy that was supposed to be in this bank was from -- I forget his name, but anyway, he was one of the members of the Abyssinian Church on (inaudible). I will never forget this. And from then on I was down on everybody. But I didn't get the money I wanted. Because Nazarro must have done something to the bank through his maneuver to cause them to freeze up the way they did on this money thing.

But I got the account opened, but they didn't get it executed like I wanted it done. I didn't get nothing executed. But I said, let it go and I'd been trying, trying, trying. So I don't get a chance to ever establish Buck and Bubbles other than that one time. The partnership I established, I esta-

blished the name of Buck and Bubbles in the bank, I got the checkbook of the bank, I still got the checkbook, you know, with the name Buck and Bubbles from the Dunbar Bank and I was in the Chemical Bank downtown under John Bubbles.

But however, I had a difficult time and that was one of the times and I wanted to bring the point of where my mother was to being where she was and how I had to get her into New York and finally my sister got married and so forth and I have to pay their second or third month's rent that they got behind in, which I knew they would do that, if they told me about it, I would never let it happen, because I could see further than they could see, you know.
